content: 1. Rifapentine decreases the levels of darunavir by increasing its metabolism through CYP3A4. This combination is contraindicated. Rifapentine also reduces the levels or effects of cobicistat via the same mechanism. Alternative drugs should be considered. 2. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of rimegepant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein efflux transporters. Similarly, cobicistat increases rimegepant levels through CYP3A4 inhibition. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 3. Darunavir increases the levels or effects of riociguat by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism and reducing its metabolism. Cobicistat also increases riociguat levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Monitor for hypotension and adjust the riociguat dose as needed. 4. Ritonavir increases the levels of darunavir and cobicistat by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 5. Cobicistat increases the levels of rivaroxaban by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration due to the increased risk of bleeding. 6. Darunavir increases the levels of romidepsin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs, as coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors should be avoided. 7. Cobicistat increases the levels of ruxolitinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Darunavir has a similar effect. Reduce the starting dose of ruxolitinib to 10 mg BID if platelet counts are ≥100 x 10^9/L. Avoid use if platelet counts are <100 x 10^9/L. 8. Cobicistat increases the levels of salmeterol by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration due to the risk of cardiovascular effects, including QT prolongation, palpitations, and sinus tachycardia. 9. Darunavir increases the levels of selpercatinib, saxagliptin, and selumetinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. If coadministration with CYP3A4 inhibitors is unavoidable, reduce the selumetinib dosage as per its monograph. 10. Darunavir increases the levels of silodosin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 11. Cobicistat increases the levels of siponimod by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with moderate or strong CYP3A4 inhibitors combined with CYP2C9 inhibitors. 12. Darunavir increases the levels of sofpironium topical by inhibiting CYP2D6 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP2D6 inhibitors. 13. Cobicistat increases the levels of solifenacin and sonidegib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 14. Darunavir and sparsentan may increase each other's toxicity through pharmacodynamic synergy. Avoid or use alternative drugs. If unavoidable, interrupt sparsentan treatment. 15. Cobicistat increases the levels of sunitinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 16. Darunavir increases the levels of suvorexant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 17. Darunavir increases the levels of tadalafil by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Adjust tadalafil dosage for pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) or erectile dysfunction (ED) as needed. 18. Cobicistat increases the levels of talazoparib by inhibiting BCRP transporters. Monitor for adverse reactions if coadministration is unavoidable. 19. Darunavir increases the levels of tamoxifen by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism, reducing its conversion to active metabolites. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 20. Darunavir increases the levels of tamsulosin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 21. Cobicistat increases the levels of tazemetostat by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 22. Darunavir increases the levels of teniposide by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 23. Cobicistat increases the levels of ticagrelor by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with strong CYP3A inhibitors. 24. Tipranavir increases the levels of darunavir and cobicistat by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 25. Darunavir increases the levels of tofacitinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Reduce the tofacitinib dose to 5 mg daily when coadministered with potent CYP3A4 inhibitors. 26. Cobicistat increases the levels of tolterodine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 27. Darunavir increases the levels of tolvaptan by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 28. Darunavir increases the levels of topotecan by inhibiting P-glycoprotein transporters. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 29. Cobicistat increases the levels of toremifene by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 30. Darunavir increases the levels of trabectedin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. If a strong CYP3A inhibitor must be used, administer it one week after trabectedin infusion and discontinue it the day before the next infusion. 31. Cobicistat increases the levels of trazodone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 32. Darunavir increases the levels of tucatinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with CYP3A substrates where minimal concentration changes may lead to serious toxicities. 33. Darunavir increases the levels of ubrogepant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 34. Cobicistat increases the levels of valbenazine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 35. Darunavir increases the levels of vemurafenib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 36. Darunavir increases the levels of venetoclax by inhibiting P-glycoprotein transporters. Reduce the venetoclax dose by at least 50% if coadministration is unavoidable. 37. Cobicistat increases the levels of vilanterol/fluticasone furoate inhaled by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 38. Darunavir increases the levels of vilazodone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Reduce the vilazodone dose to 20 mg daily if intolerable adverse effects occur. 39. Cobicistat increases the levels of vincristine liposomal by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 40. Darunavir increases the levels of vorapaxar by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 41. Darunavir increases the levels of voriconazole by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 42. Cobicistat increases the levels of zolpidem by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 43. Darunavir increases the levels of abemaciclib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Dose reduction is required when coadministered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 44. Darunavir decreases the effects of acarbose through pharmacodynamic antagonism. Monitor for hyperglycemia or diabetes exacerbation. 45. Cobicistat increases the levels of alfentanil by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor closely and adjust therapy as needed. 46. Darunavir decreases the effects of albiglutide due to insulin resistance. Monitor for hyperglycemia. 47. Darunavir increases the levels of almotriptan and alprazolam by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor closely. 48. Darunavir increases the levels of amiodarone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor closely for potential interactions. 49. Cobicistat increases the levels of amitriptyline by inhibiting CYP2D6 metabolism. Carefully titrate the antidepressant dose to achieve the desired effect. 50. Darunavir increases the levels of amlodipine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor closely for potential interactions. 51. Amobarbital decreases the levels of darunavir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor closely. 52. Cobicistat increases the levels of amoxapine by inhibiting CYP2D6 metabolism. Carefully titrate the antidepressant dose to achieve the desired effect. 53. Cobicistat increases the levels of apalutamide by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Dose reduction may be needed based on tolerability. 54. Cobicistat increases the levels of apixaban by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor closely and adjust therapy as needed. 55. Aprepitant increases the levels of darunavir by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor closely. 56. Darunavir increases the levels of aripiprazole by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Reduce the aripiprazole dose by 25–50% if coadministered with CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 inhibitors. 57. Armodafinil decreases the levels of darunavir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor closely. 58. Cobicistat and darunavir may interact with artemether/lumefantrine, potentially affecting antimalarial efficacy or prolonging the QT interval. Monitor closely. 59. Atazanavir increases the levels of darunavir by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor for immune reconstitution syndrome. 60. Cobicistat increases the levels of atogepant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Adjust the atogepant dose to 10 mg daily when coadministered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 61. Darunavir increases the levels of atorvastatin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Limit atorvastatin dose to 20 mg daily when coadministered with cobicistat. 62. Cobicistat increases the levels of avatrombopag by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Reduce the starting dose of avatrombopag when treating ITP and coadministering with CYP2C9/3A4 inhibitors. 63. Darunavir increases the levels of bazedoxifene/conjugated estrogens by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor closely. 64. Belzutifan decreases the levels of cobicistat and darunavir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Adjust therapy as needed. 65. Darunavir increases the levels of benzhydrocodone/acetaminophen by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor for respiratory depression. 66. Cobicistat increases the levels of berotralstat by inhibiting BCRP transporters. Monitor for adverse effects. 67. Darunavir increases the levels of betrixaban by inhibiting P-glycoprotein transporters. Adjust the betrixaban dose to 80 mg once, then 40 mg daily. 68. Cobicistat increases the levels of bortezomib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor closely. 69. Bosentan decreases the levels of cobicistat by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Adjust bosentan dosage as needed. 70. Darunavir increases the levels of bosutinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor closely.
